edit.description: a tap emits a runs row keyed on its requirement member

summary: A telemetry tap reaches its tool by a runs edge from the requirement that declares it, so a tool only a tap runs is no tool.degree finding
acceptance: a harness whose only runner of a tool is a tap draws no tool.degree
tests: a tool reached only by a tap draws no degree finding
notes: Note RUNNERS-REACH-THE-TEMPER-TOOL-BY-EDGE: a telemetry declaration is a requirement, not a member, so no runs row has a runner address. Once the requirement is a member (blocker), its address is the runner. Shares the runs seam with the typecheck entry.
